profile_text.body:
SoftBank Group Corp. is a Tokyo-based public company founded in 1981, listed under the ticker SFTBF and registered with the SEC under CIK 0001065521. Its Japanese-language site identifies Masayoshi Son as representative director, chairman and CEO, and presents the company's philosophy, vision and strategy alongside corporate information, shareholder and investor relations material, business segments and group companies, and sustainability and ESG information.

The site also addresses AI, describing the company's thinking in what it calls the era of the AI revolution, the work of group companies, and the possibilities AI may bring. Beyond that framing, the site text does not name specific AI products or services.

No litigation, no tracked products, and no MCP servers are recorded for the company.
